regime.method: 8 simple checks look at groups of markets over the last week and the last month. Each check votes risk-on (investors look comfortable owning riskier things), risk-off (investors look defensive) or neutral. The banner says risk-on or risk-off only when at least 60% of the checks that have data lean the same way and no more than 1 leans the other way; otherwise it says mixed.
regime.notice: A plain checklist of market groups, for research. It describes how markets behaved over the last week and month. It does not predict what comes next and it is not investment advice. No model chooses this label.

executive_summary.headline: Capital overall experiences an outflow-led month and week despite improving broad trends, while equity sectors show resilience alongside a persistent risk-off environment across major asset classes.
executive_summary.rotation_view: The overall rotation view shows money flows remain risk-off across both the month and week windows. Across weekly frames, outflows lead across Country and regional markets, Size and style, Metals, Crypto, and Real estate (REITs). Money moved out of S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, Bitcoin, Gold, and Semiconductors. However, positive weekly participation entered regional assets like Nifty 50 ETF (NIFTYBEES) and targeted groups such as US long Treasury proxy and Nifty IT ETF (ITBEES). Overall monthly trends show improving conditions despite broad selling pressure.
executive_summary.drivers_view: Corporate and market news includes updates on Meta regarding digital advertising regulations, while tax policies affecting JPMorgan in Britain draw attention. Meanwhile, technology focus centers on Nvidia following discussions around artificial intelligence debt and spending patterns. Additionally, news coverage highlights Amazon e-commerce exports out of India, alongside updates regarding Infosys bonus announcements and corporate movements involving Reliance.
